items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: The interviewer identifies the person as 'his son' (referring to Sonny Williams) and the interviewee confirms 'Mm-hmm', but the interviewee does not describe a personal relationship with this individual in the provided text.

ctx.x: Well, he was pretty, around about 18, 19 years old. He played drum with me about two years. He didn't drink them. So I meet him at the Bulls. He said, Well, Mr. Son, I'm drinking whiskey now. I'm trumpet player. I'm drinking whiskey. Yeah. He played with me a good while. Two years or three years he played.
Do you remember Pete Baddy? Baddy, no. Oh, yeah, Pete Baddy.
